title: Identity Disclosure and Anthropomorphism in Voice Chatbot Design: A Field Experiment
authors: Yuqian Xu; Hongyan Dai; Wanfeng Yan
eligible_reason: Cross-sectional randomized field experiment: 11,000 truck drivers randomly assigned to chatbot-call arms (identity disclosure, anthropomorphism features; x1-x5 arm dummies). Outcomes (response, words, order intention) regressed on arm dummies plus call/driver covariates by OLS/logit/probit; no panel, no adoption dates, no unit or time FE.
design_notes: AddLengthDef.csv is the call-level experimental dataset (Tables 2-7); Table 8 is t-tests on survey data; Table EC.1 (long-term effects) and EC.16 use an ifexp before/after-experiment indicator with day dummies in the appendix, a single experiment date, not a staggered panel.
data_files_note: README.pdf lists 14 datasets shipped in Code&Data/data; Table 8 survey data described as transformed.
data_provenance_note: Experimental call-level data shipped (survey files for Table 8 'transformed').
screener_notes: Not a DiD paper; RCT. The 'difference-in-differences' full-text flag likely refers to appendix before/after comparisons.
